CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_user_role()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  SELECT role
  FROM public.users
  WHERE id = auth.uid()
$function$
